title: 1630 Prairie's alley shed is built, finishing the north-west alley
items: The small one-storey frame shed behind 1630 Prairie now stands in clapboard, built board by board like the house in front of it, on the outline the 1911 fire-insurance map draws.
The map's tiny cross gives it a shingle roof. An 1886 atlas shows the lot's rear empty, so the shed went up some time after that.
Every building along the alley from 1600 to 1736 Prairie has now moved past its first rough draft.
